rationale: Build NVIDIA gross-profit and cash-generation workpapers through Q2FY2026. Reconstruct Q1 for both years from first-half and Q2 inputs, calculate standard gross-profit bases, and add the current-year H20 charge/release bridge without treating missing prior exclusions as zero. Reconcile issuer cash generation and assess the geographical and forward-looking H20 statements.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
starting_defects: not applicable - no starting SQL supplied
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: NVIDIA made no H20 shipments to China during Q3 FY2026.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: The supplied Q2 release contains a Q3 guidance assumption of no China H20 shipments. It supplies no realized Q3 shipments, so neither zero nor nonzero actual shipments are established.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: Inventory releases reverse the sign of an exclusion while multiple margin bases coexist. Half-year reconstruction, cash principal and absent geographic observations make this an interacting update rather than a revenue lookup.

public_definition_addenda.gross_profit_bases: Adjusted gross profit is GAAP gross profit plus signed standard adjustments. residual_usd_million is reconstructed adjusted gross profit less reported adjusted gross profit.
public_definition_addenda.current_h20_bridge: excluded_gross_profit_usd_million is standard adjusted gross profit plus the source-signed H20 charge or release. excluded_gross_margin_pct is 100 times that reconstructed amount divided by matching revenue. residual_usd_million is reconstructed excluded gross profit less independently reported excluded gross profit.
public_definition_addenda.cash_generation: Issuer FCF is operating cash flow less positive property and intangible purchases and less disclosed positive property and intangible principal. residual_usd_million is reconstructed FCF less independently reported FCF for the same period.
